title: x402 Spend-Evidence VPSF Bridge
description: Renders the x402-spend-evidence chain's assembled x402_spend_evidence pack (EIP-712 digest recompute, ECDSA signer recovery, domain/nonce/window check) as a VPSF SettlementReceipt + DelegationGrant Payment Claim pair, JCS-hashed via RFC 8785 canonicalisation and SHA-256, joined by a Conjunction composite. Verifiable offline by any VPSF-conformant verifier, including this suite's own VPSF Claim Algebra Verifier. Structural evidence only: never a settlement-finality claim.

spend_evidence_pack.description: The x402-spend-evidence chain's assembled §8 x402_spend_evidence pack: digest, domain_separator, struct_hash, recovered_signer, claimed_from, recovered_signer_matches_claimed_from, domain_chain_match, domain_contract_match, authorization_within_window, nonce_well_formed, nonce_already_used, authorization{from,to,value,validAfter,validBefore,nonce}, verdict

execution_hash_of_origin.description: execution_hash of the chain-step artifact that produced the pack (e.g. art-592's), carried through into the emitted claims' evidence field, never trusted, only displayed

mcp_tool_definition.name: emit_x402_spendevidence_vpsf_claims
mcp_tool_definition.description: Renders an x402_spend_evidence pack (from the x402-spend-evidence chain) as a VPSF SettlementReceipt + DelegationGrant claim pair with a conjunction composite, JCS-hashed per draft-vauban-x402-vpsf-algebra-01. Browser-based, client-side only, zero network calls, zero PII. Refuses to emit when the source pack does not itself establish a valid, unreplayed, in-window authorization.
